description: Advance the game: shift lanes, fire, optionally use a superzapper, for a number of ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Returns what happened and the new board.

fire.description: Hold fire during this step. Default true.

move.description: Lanes to shift, one lane per tick. Negative moves to lower lane numbers. Default 0.

zap.description: Use one superzapper (3 per game) on the first tick. Default false.

name: step
title: Play a step
